retrievalProfile.description: A staggered group portrait of four men with voluminous 80s hairstyles, featuring high-contrast lighting and a mix of hand-drawn and geometric cut-out typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, multi-layered composition of four male subjects with prominent 1980s hairstyles and leather attire, framed by expressive white script at the top and rigid, vertically elongated block text on geometric tabs at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Staggered vertical arrangement of faces creating a diagonal flow
Contrast between organic hair textures and smooth leather surfaces
Juxtaposition of expressive hand-drawn script and rigid geometric typography
Dark, moody background focusing attention on facial features and highlights
coreInvariants: Voluminous 80s-style textured hair on all subjects
Black leather jackets or dark shirts as primary wardrobe

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged in a diamond-like staggered formation, filling the frame from top-left to bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central face in the middle-right, which has the most direct gaze and clearest lighting.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-left script, down through the staggered faces, ending at the bottom typographic banner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects and text elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and highlights on the hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white for the top script and muted grey for the bottom text tabs.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark shadows and bright highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, black, and white

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Mixed: expressive script and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Hand-drawn, brush-like strokes with rough, distressed edges.
Bottom text: Extremely condensed, vertically elongated sans-serif capitals.
Bottom text is placed on individual grey geometric 'tabs' or 'strips' with jagged edges.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' in the top script has a long, sweeping tail.
The 'M' and 'N' in the bottom text are ultra-narrow with no internal spacing.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, expressive top script and rigid, mechanical bottom block text.
graphicDevices: Jagged-edged grey rectangular tabs behind bottom letters

preserve: Rough brush texture of top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the hand-drawn energy of the top title.
Provides the necessary verticality for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of four men with 80s-style voluminous hair, wearing black leather jackets, arranged in a staggered diagonal formation against a dark, textured background with high-contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a white hand-drawn brush script at the top. At the bottom, place ultra-condensed white sans-serif capital letters on individual grey jagged-edged rectangular tabs.

verificationChecks: Check for 80s hair volume and texture
Ensure bottom text is on individual grey tabs
Verify top script has a distressed, painterly edge

mustRedesign: Do not use standard sans-serif fonts without condensation
postGenerationChecks: Is the top text white and brush-like?
Is the bottom text ultra-condensed on grey strips?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep shadows?
